QUOTE: "the deny-list check in `ServerManager::execute` comes second, right before routing." and "`ServerManager::execute` ├─ is_denied(tool, pattern) ───► "Error: Permission denied" └─ route_tool_call"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the deny check precedes routing in `execute`, but it also describes an earlier approval layer (`check_approval`) that can block with "Permission denied". It never concludes that the deny list is the only blocker, and it contradicts that claim.
